title: Aklex
extract:
The Aklex are a pair of  Lex pistols. Compared to a single Lex, the Aklex have a higher rate of fire and magazine size. However, they have no polarity slot, lower accuracy, and a slower reload speed.
This weapon can be sold for ‍5,000.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage.

Very good ammunition efficiency.

Acquisition
The Aklex's blueprint can be purchased from the Market.

Notes
Despite the description of the Aklex saying that its reload time suffers, its actual reload time is quite efficient, spanning a mere 1.27 times its original reload duration, as most akimbo pistols have twice the reload time.
Despite the accuracy mentioned in its statistics is poor, its actual accuracy is quite impressive, even when against long-ranged targets, leaving only the recoil to be held responsible for this.

Tips
A  Stunning Speed mod synergizes well with this weapon, reducing its long reload and increasing its high status chance further (although not by much).
 Steady Hands makes the Aklex's high recoil much easier to control and allow for more accurate shots on the target in a shorter span of time without having to readjust after shots as often.

Trivia
The Aklex and its Prime and singular variants share similar weapon sounds to the Hammer 1895, a revolver featured in Dark Sector.
